title.zh: AI困惑度：OpenAI提议共享进展指标
title.en: AI Perplexity: OpenAI Proposes a Shared Progress Metric

excerpt.zh: OpenAI主张用困惑度追踪预训练进展，并探讨行业共享评估与安全标准；但该指标不能直接衡量具体能力，跨实验室比较也有难题。
excerpt.en: OpenAI argues that perplexity can track pretraining progress and inform shared AI safety standards, while warning that it does not directly measure task abilities and is hard to compare across labs.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: OpenAI首席科学家Jakub Pachocki提出，应把困惑度（通常以对数困惑度或交叉熵损失衡量）作为观察AI预训练进展的共同指标。它衡量模型预测未见文本下一个词元的表现，数值越低，预测越准确。OpenAI公布了自身追踪的部分预训练测量结果，希望推动行业透明度。
text.en: OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki argues that perplexity, commonly tracked as log-perplexity or cross-entropy loss, could serve as a shared measure of AI pretraining progress. It measures how well a model predicts the next token in unseen text; lower values indicate better predictions. OpenAI has disclosed some of its own tracking data in a bid to encourage greater industry transparency.

text.zh: 指标可能提示能力变化，但不是能力清单
text.en: A signal of progress, not a capability checklist

text.zh: 文章回顾了预训练损失下降与模型能力演进之间的联系：从连贯写作，到少样本任务学习、流畅对话和推理，再到数学与网络安全领域出现的突出表现。作者强调，这些能力并非在特定数值处必然出现；相关联系是回顾性的观察，而不是可靠的能力预测公式。
text.en: The post connects falling pretraining loss with changes in model behavior, from coherent writing to few-shot learning, fluent conversation and reasoning, and then notable performance in mathematics and cybersecurity. Pachocki stresses that these capabilities were not guaranteed to appear at particular thresholds. The relationship is an observation about past progress, not a dependable formula for predicting what a model can do.

text.zh: Pachocki还认为，AI对预训练算法研究的参与可能加快进展，并提出未来几年出现研究突破的可能性。文章同时主张，前沿模型开发者应共同制定评估、红队测试和透明度规范，并考虑在监测能力达到具体里程碑前设定发展限制。这是作者的建议与预期，并非已达成的行业共识。
text.en: Pachocki also argues that AI participation in research on pretraining algorithms could accelerate progress, and suggests that major research advances might arrive in the coming years. He calls for frontier developers to establish shared evaluation, red-teaming and transparency practices, and to consider limits on development until monitoring reaches defined milestones. These are proposals and expectations, not standards the industry has already adopted.

text.zh: 共享使用仍有关键限制
困惑度并不直接对应人们关心的任务能力；不同实验室的数据集和训练数据也不一致，难以公平比较。它还无法反映预训练之外的改进，例如思维链推理带来的能力变化，而模型对评估的适应也可能削弱安全审计。作者因此把困惑度视为有用但不充分的指标：若要据此协调研发节奏，仍需可迁移的评测方法，以及明确、可验证的安全监测里程碑。
text.en: Perplexity does not directly measure performance on tasks people care about, and differences in datasets and training mixtures make comparisons across labs difficult. It also misses gains outside pretraining, such as changes associated with chain-of-thought reasoning, while models becoming more aware of evaluations may weaken safety audits. The post therefore presents perplexity as useful but incomplete. Using it to coordinate development would still require transferable evaluations and concrete, verifiable milestones for safety monitoring.
